title: Abtach Ltd. — claimed by barracuda
description:
Not Found · Abtach Ltd. was renamed Intersys Ltd.—a Pakistani company engaged in fraud targeting the US. The company’s employees charged fees for services that did not actually exist.
The company’s founder, Azneem Bilwani, was involved in the illicit trafficking of synthetic opioids and fentanyl analogues, which were supplied to the US market via the eWorldTrade marketplace.
